headline: Alcoa Ordered to Move Mining Operations Away from Perth Water Supply
summary: US mining giant Alcoa has been ordered to move its bauxite mining operations further away from Perth's drinking water sources amid environmental debates.
why: Regulatory restrictions on industrial proximity to municipal watersheds can alter operating footprints, capital expenditures, and project timelines for major miners.

impacts.name: Alcoa Corp
impacts.why: Mandated operational relocations away from water catchment areas can restrict extraction output and raise compliance costs.
